predictions.rationale: Central class that defines the UML Deployment Diagram type, including its visual representation and behavior; directly implements the requested feature.
Provides the graph (model) logic for deployment diagrams, managing nodes, artifacts, and their mappings—core to the runtime-architecture view.
UI action that creates/opens a Deployment Diagram; key entry point for users to work with the feature.
Factory responsible for instantiating diagrams, including Deployment Diagrams; essential support for creating and managing them within projects.
Handles textual notation for NodeInstance elements, which are primary constituents of deployment diagrams (hardware nodes at runtime).
Explorer navigation rule that links a diagram to its Node elements; specifically relevant for browsing nodes in deployment diagrams.
Property-panel model for selecting classifiers of component (artifact) instances, which are mapped onto nodes in deployment diagrams.
Abstract base for all UML diagrams; deployment diagrams inherit common behaviors defined here, making it an indirect but important support file.
Interface for diagram factories; ensures deployment diagram creation is supported across different factory implementations.
Concrete implementation of UML diagrams providing shared infrastructure (rendering, serialization) used by deployment diagrams.
